sourceQuote: 4.Starting Date: September 1 to 5, 2011 Application Deadline: July 15th, 2011 Notes: Those who miss the application deadline can submit your application materials before September 1st, 2011 at the latest.
targetQuote: 4.开课日期：1 月 5 日至 2011 日 申请截止日期：15 月 2011 日 备注：错过申请截止日期者，可于 1 月 2011 日前提交申请材料，逾期不予受理。
